Precondition: MPP_Sim running; a SerializedMipStation UDT instance exists with a /plc-devices mapping to its terminal
Step: Inspect the serialized MIP UDT instance members against the 5GO_AP4 Touchpoint Agreement
Expected Result: Instance exposes DataReady, TransInProc, PartSN, PartValid, HardwareInterlockEnforced, WatchDog, ContainerCount, PartType and the alarm member per FDS-10-001
Notes: Simulator-validated against MPP_Sim; live device tag-map (OpcServer/Device/BasePath) applied at hardware commissioning

Precondition: A TerminalPlcDevice mapping row exists for the station
Step: Open /plc-devices and confirm the serialized station terminal is bound to its `[MPP]PlcDevices/<device>` instance path
Expected Result: Mapping resolves (PlcWatcher.dispatch finds the terminal + device type); edges on the instance route to the SerializedMip watcher

Precondition: A LOT is queued at the assembly-out terminal; Sim Panel /dev/sim/plc open on the device
Step: Seed a valid PartSN (>=6) with HardwareInterlockEnforced=True and fire DataReady
Expected Result: MES sets TransInProc, reads PartSN + interlock, mints the serialized part against the FIFO front LOT, writes PartValid=1, then resets TransInProc + DataReady; a PlcHandshake InterfaceLog row is written
Notes: Simulator-validated via /dev/sim/plc against the live watcher

Precondition: Serialized MIP device selected in the Sim Panel; a LOT queued at the terminal
Step: Fire DataReady with HardwareInterlockEnforced=False and a blank PartSN
Expected Result: Validation is skipped (NoRead path, FDS-06-012); SerializedPart_Mint auto-generates a serial and the part is accepted with PartValid=1

Precondition: A serialized part with a given PartSN already exists
Step: Fire DataReady re-using that duplicate PartSN
Expected Result: Mint is rejected — PartValid=0, alarm text written (HMI-gated), and a failed PlcHandshake row is logged to Audit.InterfaceLog
Notes: Duplicate dedup is enforced in SerializedPart_Mint; simulator-validated

Precondition: Serialized MIP device in the Sim Panel
Step: Attempt the Invalid-PartSN and Low-Inventory alarm cases
Expected Result: Alarm message surfaces to the operator/HMI for each
Notes: Only the duplicate/rejection alarm is wired today; the invalid-PartSN min-length gate and the low-inventory-threshold alarm are proc-level commissioning fill-ins (flagged in the runbook §E)

Precondition: A NonSerializedMipStation instance mapped to a 5A2-style terminal; Sim Panel open
Step: Fire DataReady on the non-serialized device
Expected Result: Watcher sets TransInProc, acknowledges the handshake, logs it, and resets TransInProc + DataReady
Notes: Handshake choreography simulator-validated; the FG + tray-piece-count line config (_resolveLineConfig) is a commissioning fill-in — until supplied the completion mint is deliberately skipped (not faked), per runbook §E

Precondition: A TrayInspectionStation device selected in the Sim Panel
Step: Fire InspectionComplete with a mix of PartDisposition slot flags set
Expected Result: The 18 PartDisposition slots are read by the watcher
Notes: Disposition slots are read; the passed-parts-count / open-container tray-close bookkeeping is line-specific commissioning (runbook §E)

Precondition: A LOT queued at the tray-inspection terminal whose Item.PlcId is set; Sim Panel open
Step: Fire TrayLocked on the tray-inspection device
Expected Result: The front FIFO LOT's Item.PlcId is written to the instance PartNumber member (the PLC vision recipe is selected before inspection)

Precondition: TrayLocked already fired (recipe selected) for the front LOT
Step: Fire InspectionComplete with a VisionPartNumber that does NOT match the expected recipe
Expected Result: LINE STOP — OkToContinue stays false (tray left locked, no release), a PlcLineStop event is written to Audit.InterfaceLog, and the HMI alarm is raised (gated); the LOT's LotStatusCode is left untouched (no Hold)
Notes: Simulator-validated; line-stop signal to the PLC is asserted by holding OkToContinue false. Optional formal Quality.Hold on mismatch is a deliberate policy hook, not auto-placed

Precondition: TrayLocked already fired for the front LOT
Step: Fire InspectionComplete with a VisionPartNumber matching the expected recipe
Expected Result: OkToContinue=1 (tray released) and the ByVision tray close runs through Assembly_CompleteTray (mints the FG LOT + consumes BOM)

Precondition: A tray-inspection cell
Step: Drive 10 consecutive vision-mismatch failures at the cell and confirm the escalation behaviour
Expected Result: On the 10th consecutive fail the line leader is auto-escalated (LeaderEscalationFlagged), a supervisor-dashboard badge fires, supervisor AD elevation (FDS-04-007) is required to resume, and the counter resets on the next pass
Notes: NOT YET WIRED — the consecutive-fail counter, LeaderEscalationFlagged event, supervisor-resume gate, and the LineStopConsecutiveFailThreshold LocationAttribute are a commissioning fill-in. Today each mismatch records an independent line-stop with no cross-cycle counter

Precondition: A tray-inspection cell
Step: Exercise each failure type and confirm the branch
Expected Result: Wrong-part (vision != operator) flags the leader immediately; wrong-orientation stops but does not escalate; PartDisposition fail counts toward the 10-fail threshold; barcode mis-scan does not stop the line
Notes: NOT YET WIRED — failure-type branching is not implemented; the watcher records a uniform vision-mismatch line-stop. Commissioning fill-in

Precondition: A LOT is on Hold
Step: As a Quality-role user, AD-elevate (FDS-04-007) and release the hold via the Quality hold screen
Expected Result: The HoldEvent row closes (ReleasedAt set) and the LOT's LotStatusCode returns to Good (Hold_Release)
Notes: Witnessable directly in the Quality hold UI

Precondition: A LOT is on Hold; logged in as an operator without elevation
Step: Attempt to release the hold directly
Expected Result: Release is blocked — operators cannot release holds; the action is elevation-gated

Precondition: A LOT is on Hold
Step: Release the hold as Quality with a Controlled Run Tag disposition
Expected Result: The hold closes, LotStatusCode returns to Good, and Lot.CrtActive is set to 1; the next downstream operation screen forces the 200% double-capture
Notes: CRT activate/clear procs built; the 200%-inspect double-capture is view-enforced off getRequiredInspections (not proc-gated) in v1

Precondition: A CRT-active LOT (CrtActive=1) reaches its next operation
Step: Complete the forced 200% inspection (or skip it)
Expected Result: On completion CrtActive clears (Lot_ClearCrt, supervisor-elevated) with a CrtCompleted result; if the CRT run passed through un-inspected the LOT is flagged for re-run with a MissedCrtInspect hold

Precondition: A ScaleStation instance mapped to an assembly terminal; Sim Panel open
Step: Seed a net weight with MetFlag=False and fire NET_DataReady
Expected Result: The watcher reads NET_NetWeightValue / UOM / TargetWeightMetFlag, acknowledges NET_DataReady, and logs the weigh to Audit.InterfaceLog; no container close occurs
Notes: Simulator-validated; raw-weight persistence (a ProductionEvent/QualitySample) is a commissioning fill-in — weight is captured in the InterfaceLog payload only

Precondition: ScaleStation device selected in the Sim Panel
Step: Fire NET_DataReady with MetFlag=True
Expected Result: The scale is coupled to container completion — a ByWeight tray close runs through Assembly_CompleteTray at the configured ByWeight piece count; the container auto-completes (AIM + label) when full

Precondition: A plant-floor screen with an active LTT input field
Step: Scan a valid LTT barcode with the terminal's keyboard-wedge scanner
Expected Result: Scan data is injected as keystrokes into the active field (no custom driver); on submit the server validates the LTT format (9-digit + checksum, ufn_IsValidExternalLtt) and accepts it
Notes: Witnessable directly; keyboard-wedge behaviour is client-side plus server-side format validation

Precondition: A plant-floor screen with an active LTT input field
Step: Scan a malformed / wrong-format barcode
Expected Result: Server-side format validation rejects the scan with an operator toast; no LOT action is taken

Precondition: A PLC-integrated assembly Cell
Step: Inspect the Cell's ConfirmationMethod LocationAttribute
Expected Result: The attribute is seeded and readable with an allowed value (Vision / Barcode / Both) declaring which source(s) confirm part identity

Precondition: A Cell whose ConfirmationMethod = Both
Step: Present a vision read and a barcode read that disagree on part identity
Expected Result: The production event does not record until both sources agree; the mismatch counts toward the line-stop threshold, and a supervisor-elevated manual override logs HardwareInterlockBypassed on the ContainerSerial
Notes: Attribute is seeded and read by the proc/UI; the full Both-reconcile enforcement + override path mirrors the FDS-10-005 line-stop and is partly a commissioning fill-in
